title: MeegXer session
description: Everything needed to repeat a run: the pipeline (validated separately against pipeline.schema.json), the node versions and provenance, fitted models, input and output hashes and the software environment. Only meegxer_session and pipeline are required; a missing section is simply not pinned. Paths are relative to the session file unless absolute. See session.md. Session format 1.0, spec version 0.2.9 (unstable).

meegxer_session.description: Session format version (major.minor). Readers accept the same major version.

models.description: Per node id: the fitted model of a node that needs calibration.

inputs.description: Per source node id: the files it read.

outputs.description: Files the run wrote (acceptance test 4 compares their hashes).

provenance.description: Where the implementation comes from. External plugins: image, image_id, repo_digests; local plugins and custom scripts: command, unsandboxed, sha256 (of their code files) and script. Empty or absent for built-in nodes.

review.description: A review strip's review (docs/REVIEW.md): who reviewed (left out when the session is shared), when (ISO 8601, UTC), and the fingerprint of the input it was made on. The marks are in the review's own sidecar.

references.description: What to cite for this node, from its manifest (spec 0.2.12).

fingerprint.description: The node's input fingerprint at fitting time; a model whose fingerprint does not match the pipeline it is loaded into needs refitting.

data.description: The model as the node returned it. Arrays are {"__array__": dtype, "shape": [...], "data": nested lists} (complex: "real" and "imag" instead of "data"); non-finite floats are the strings NaN, Infinity, -Infinity inside arrays and {"__float__": ...} elsewhere.

signal.description: The channels the model was fitted on.
